fields.description: When off, Meta's webhook check still works but incoming messages are ignored.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Paste into Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Callback URL.
fields.label: Webhook Callback URL

fields.description: Optional. WhatsApp Business Account ID, for reference.
fields.label: Business Account ID

fields.description: Permanent token of a System User in Meta Business Settings.
fields.label: Access Token

fields.description: Meta app: App settings > Basic > App secret. Used to check that webhook calls come from Meta.
fields.label: App Secret

fields.description: Any long random text; enter the same value in Meta next to the Callback URL.
fields.label: Webhook Verify Token

fields.description: Shown as Reported by on community reports. Created on migrate if empty.
fields.label: Community Reporter Account

fields.description: Used to match staff mobile numbers written as 07... with WhatsApp numbers.
fields.label: Default Country Code

fields.description: After this long without a reply, an unfinished report asks Continue / Start over.
fields.label: Idle Minutes

fields.description: Optional public https link to the KRCS logo (JPEG/PNG), sent before the first welcome.
fields.label: Welcome Image URL

fields.description: WhatsApp numbers alerted for every new WhatsApp report, one per line (e.g. 254712345678).
fields.label: Desk Alert Numbers

fields.description: Questions the chatbot cannot answer go here, one per line. Empty: the desk alert numbers.
fields.label: Escalation Numbers

fields.description: Approved Utility template with 5 body variables: reference, what, where, affected, reporter. Without it, alerts are plain text and only reach numbers that wrote to the bot in the last 24 hours.
fields.label: Alert Template Name

fields.description: Optional, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8100. Empty: "Ask a question" is not offered.
fields.label: Chatbot URL

fields.description: Optional: the NLP extraction service (POST /extract). Empty: the Chatbot URL above; with neither, free-text reports use a keyword fallback.
fields.label: Extraction URL
